Take the volume below the step where the system stops.

Android media volume has only integer steps, and the lowest step is often still loud. Whisper Volume adds a software attenuation layer to the global media output. It does not alter the audio content; it only lowers the level, by up to another 48 dB.
Music, video, podcasts and other media, over Bluetooth, wired output or the phone speaker. The floating strip lets you adjust while watching or listening in another app.
Phone calls, alarms, keyboard sounds and system UI sounds usually take separate audio paths and are not affected. This is an Android platform limitation.

string-array.name: bt_troubleshooting_steps
string-array.item: Make sure the system media volume is already at its lowest step.
Move Extra attenuation to −24 dB or lower (−36 to −48 dB).
If nothing changes at all, close other equalizer or volume-booster apps.
Try a local music player. A few phone and headset combinations bypass global audio effects.
Some headsets need Disable absolute volume enabled in Developer options, followed by a reconnect.
